evidence: Per-wave sequence: 0) update state.json with current wave, 1) save checkpoint to .wabblespec/checkpoints/wave-N-timestamp/, 2) run Guard (PASS required before proceeding; HARD->abort; SPEC_VIOLATION->pause), 3) implement wave outputs, 4) run Verifier (PASS->write receipt+advance; FAIL->REVISE loop max 3; BLOCKED->Attestation), 5) write wave receipt. Post-all-waves: module-build acceptance gate (AUGMENT) — if task_type is module-build, verify tests/acceptance.md exists at modules/{layer}/{module_id}/tests/acceptance.md before writing execution-receipt.json; absent->ACCEPTANCE_NOT_COVERED; present->acceptance_verified: true. Error types: SOFT(retry once), HARD(halt+rollback), DEPENDENCY(pause), CONTEXT_EXHAUSTION(compress+resume), SPEC_VIOLATION(loop back), STALENESS_VIOLATION(quarantine).
